pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "OpenAI Codex is bundled into ChatGPT plans. The Free tier costs $0 with limited trial access, Plus is $20/month with 10–60 cloud tasks per 5-hour window, Pro 5x is $100/month… Pro 20x is $200/month… The new Pro 5x tier at $100/month (launched April 2026)"

has_free_tier.note: Limited trial access on the ChatGPT Free tier.

platforms.evidence: Web search summary: "These plans include access across web, CLI, IDE extensions, and iOS platforms"

nl.tagline: OpenAI's coding agent in de cloud, CLI en editor
nl.description: Codex is de programmeeragent van OpenAI. Hij voert taken uit in een cloudomgeving of lokaal via de CLI en editor-extensies: features bouwen, bugs oplossen, code reviewen en pull requests voorstellen. Inbegrepen bij betaalde ChatGPT-plannen.
bestFor: Taken parallel in de cloud laten uitvoeren
limitations: Gebruik begrensd per tijdvenster, afhankelijk van het ChatGPT-plan

en.tagline: OpenAI's coding agent in the cloud, CLI and editor
en.description: Codex is OpenAI's coding agent. It runs tasks in a cloud environment or locally through the CLI and editor extensions: building features, fixing bugs, reviewing code and proposing pull requests. Included with paid ChatGPT plans.
bestFor: Running tasks in parallel in the cloud
limitations: Usage capped per time window depending on the ChatGPT plan
